messages.previewIntro: What an agent gets at the start of a session in this folder:
messages.previewNone: Nothing: no active rule applies here.
messages.previewCut: {count} cut to stay within the limit.
messages.importNone: No lines to import in that file.
messages.importHint: Pick the lines to keep. They become active when you add them.
messages.problem.too-long: Too long: the rule up to 160 characters, why 300, when 200.
messages.problem.steps: A rule is one sentence, not steps.
messages.problem.command: A rule is a preference, not a command.
messages.problem.path: A path belongs only in a project rule.
messages.problem.ostia-name: A rule holds no OSTIA_ name.
messages.problem.capability: A rule cannot touch permissions, approvals, sandboxes or hooks.
messages.problem.about-ostia: A rule is not about Ostia or other agents.
messages.problem.redact-failed: The text could not be checked, so nothing was saved.
